epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local environment setup time from >10 mins to <1 min
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml file at the repository root that starts the full stack and exposes a health-check endpoint.

slices.title: Add Docker Compose for full stack
slices.jtbd: When implementing the containerization for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose.yml file, so that the full stack can be launched locally and observability is improved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository without container orchestration,
When a developer runs docker-compose up,
Then the backend, frontend, and database start successfully and expose a health-check endpoint.
Given the running stack,
When calling the health-check endpoint,
Then it returns a 200 OK status.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce number of manual startup commands from >3 to 1

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce manual database updates from >5 per week to 0
requirements: R1: Implement UI for updating and deleting existing epidemiological materials.

slices.title: Patch Material UI with Update and Delete
slices.jtbd: When implementing material management UI for this epic, I want to add update and delete actions, so that materials can be maintained directly from the interface.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the catalog,
When a user clicks the edit button and saves changes,
Then the frontend invokes the PUT API endpoint and updates the view.
Given an existing material,
When a user clicks the delete button and confirms,
Then the frontend invokes the DELETE API endpoint and removes it from the view.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce frontend unhandled CRUD actions from >2 to 0

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization Mechanism
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized access incidents from >0 to 0
requirements: R1: Introduce a standard authentication and session mechanism to block unauthenticated access to the catalog and material creation.

slices.title: Patch Existing Code with Authentication
slices.jtbd: When implementing authentication for this epic, I want to add a login flow and session protection, so that sensitive data access is restricted.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user,
When they attempt to access the catalog or create a material,
Then they are blocked and prompted to log in.
Given a user providing valid credentials,
When they log in,
Then a session is established and access to the catalog is granted.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthenticated route access success rate from 100% to 0%
